presenter_direction.script_handling: Use the existing narration script exactly; do not add spoken disclosure or stage directions.
presenter_direction.camera_direction: Vertical medium close-up, eyes near upper third, caption-safe lower third.
presenter_direction.delivery_notes: Warm, practical, human, low-pressure, with light empathy on the prospect pain point.
presenter_direction.pacing_notes: Natural short pauses between beats; do not rush the CTA.
presenter_direction.disclosure_notes: Disclosure belongs in caption/final QA metadata, not the spoken script.
presenter_direction.safety_notes: Do not imply the presenter is a real employee, customer, or prospect.

framing: 9:16 medium close-up with stable eye contact and room for renderer-owned captions.
gesture_policy: Use restrained natural hand gestures only; avoid pointing, exaggerated sales gestures, or testimonial-like emphasis.
motion_prompt: Subtle natural head movement, calm eye contact, slight expression changes aligned to the narration.
background_policy: Simple neutral studio-style background with no readable signage, private documents, or implied real office location.
caption_policy: Provider captions disabled; renderer/caption stages own subtitles and disclosure metadata.

provider_request_options.motion_prompt: Subtle natural presenter motion with calm eye contact.

decision_summary.rationale: Synthetic presenter use is allowed because account policy permits avatar mode, consent/disclosure metadata is present, and provider avatar/voice IDs are configured for runtime generation.

director_avatar_request.notes: Use a transparent synthetic presenter for the full Reel if provider configuration is present.

constraints: Provider call is allowed only for asset generation.
Disclosure is required outside the spoken script.
Final QA and Studio approval remain required.

presenter_profile.description: Synthetic presenter profile for low-pressure sales education. It must never be framed as a real employee, prospect, or customer.

usage_restrictions: Must pass final QA before publish approval.
consent.verification_notes: Synthetic presenter profile is internally approved for this fixture.

presenter_profile.notes: Provider IDs are non-secret fixture identifiers and must match runtime provider inventory before any live call.

usage_restrictions_checked: Must pass final QA before publish approval.
consent_evaluation.evidence: Consent metadata, usage restrictions, disclosure text, and HeyGen provider IDs are present.

handoff_notes: Generate an avatar video asset only after runtime revalidates consent and provider config.
Do not publish until final QA passes and Studio approval is recorded.

fallback_plan.reason: If consent, disclosure, provider identity, or provider configuration fails at runtime, auto-downgrade to the normal video reel path.
fallback_plan.visual_direction: Use provider-generated scene videos with the existing narration and no avatar presenter.

quality_gates.evidence: Consent record URI and usage restrictions are present.
HeyGen avatar and voice IDs are present.
Final QA must re-check disclosure and consent before approval.

implementation_notes.notes: Active avatar runtime may call HeyGen for asset generation only; publish safety is unchanged.
